name: OnaFlix Data Pipeline
postCreateCommand: go mod download && pg_isready -h localhost -U gitpod || (pg_ctlcluster 16 main start && sleep 2) && psql -h localhost -U gitpod -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'onaflix'" | grep -q 1 || psql -h localhost -U gitpod -c 'CREATE DATABASE onaflix'
